blocks.text: Tomat provides managed focus sessions, pauses, breaks and a Waybar status control. The popup menu starts a reviewed preset, pauses or resumes the current session, skips a break, stops the session, and opens Tomat settings.

A session is owned by labwc-tomat.service in the user session and its break overlay is separate. Closing the menu does not stop an active session. Use Stop when you intend to end it; use Pause / Resume when you only need a temporary interruption.

Tomat notification, sound and overlay settings are session preferences. If a break is not visible, check the Waybar status and the notification quiet mode before starting another session. Do not run a second timer daemon to work around a missing notification.
